Format: Vertical 9:16 Portrait for mobile social feeds.
Safety zones: Keep the bottom fifth and left/right lateral edges clear of faces and focal subjects to accommodate UI buttons, comments, captions, and account tags.
Character: Maya, a 28-year-old barista with olive skin, tied-back curly dark hair, wearing a forest-green canvas apron over a charcoal longsleeve tee.
Setting: Cozy urban coffee bar with warm pendant tungsten lighting and rainy street window reflections.

Maya glanced at the ticking clock behind the espresso bar as rain lashed the cafe windows.
She poured steaming oat milk into the ceramic cup, etching a delicate rosetta on the dark crema.
Suddenly, a hurried commuter burst through the brass door, soaking wet and clutching a sealed parchment envelope.
